name: br.com.bemobi.medescope.service.impl.DMIntentService
description: The Bemobi Medescope download library starts this service after a download finishes or its notification is tapped. It matches the Android download to the app request and sends the completion result or opens the queue.
disableEffect: The app may not receive Medescope download results, and download notification taps may stop opening the queue.
